title: Billing-Error Courtesy Credit
content:
A duplicate charge refunded on a membership of Northgate Memberships in the three months before the cancellation adds a billing-error courtesy credit of 10.00 dollars, one refunded 3 to 11 whole months before adds 5.00 dollars, and none adds nothing. The credit is added to the cancellation refund.

| Duplicate-charge refund on the membership, by refund date | Billing-error courtesy credit |
|---|---|
| fewer than 3 whole months before the cancellation | 10.00 |
| none within 3 months; one 3 to 11 whole months before | 5.00 |
| none, or only ones 12 or more whole months before | nothing |

**Reading the records.** The refunds counted are refund entries on the membership's ledger whose reason is a duplicate charge, dated by the day the refund was issued. Whole months run from that date to the cancellation date, a month counting only when the cancellation date's day of the month has reached the refund date's day of the month.

## Hypothetical cases (cancellation on 15 September 2027)

| Duplicate-charge refund issued | Whole months before | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 16 June 2027 | 2 | 10.00 |
| 15 June 2027 | 3 | 5.00 |
| 16 September 2026 | 11 | 5.00 |
| 15 September 2026 | 12 | nothing |
